facts.raw_span: A 61-year-old African American woman
bilateral knee osteoarthritis
acute bilateral knee swelling and pain, left greater than right
denied fever, chills, or malaise
right knee had a suprapatellar effusion, range of motion 0–70°, no erythema, and no pain with micromotion
left knee had a moderate suprapatellar effusion, range of motion 0–30°, no erythema, and pain with micromotion
peripheral white blood cell count of 12.8×10^3/mm³
C-reactive protein level of 159 mg/L
erythrocyte sedimentation rate of 79 mm/hr
Left knee, 38,580 WBC/mm³, negative gram stain, negative cultures
Right knee, 29,670 WBC/mm³, negative gram stain, negative cultures
onset of pain 12 hours after the injections
